options.name: add
options.description: The properties to add to an existing change. At least one of 'add', 'replace', or 'remove' is required when state is 'update'. Ignored for other states.

options.name: briefDescription
options.description: The brief description of the new change. If longer than 80 characters, only the first 80 characters will be used. If not provided, the brief description of the template is used. Ignored if state is not 'new'.

options.name: changeId
options.description: The ID of the change to manipulate. Required unless state is 'new'.

options.name: debug
options.description: Adds debug logging to the output.

options.name: externalNumber
options.description: An optional external number. Ignored if state is not 'new'.

options.name: file
options.description: The filename to be uploaded to the change. Ignored if state is not 'upload'

options.name: object
options.description: Name of the object that should be linked. Ignored if state is not 'new'

options.name: remove
options.description: The properties to remove to an existing change. At least one of 'add', 'replace', or 'remove' is required when state is 'update'. Ignored for other states.

options.name: replace
options.description: The properties to replace to an existing change. At least one of 'add', 'replace', or 'remove' is required when state is 'update'. Ignored for other states.

options.name: request
options.description: The request text. Can be multiline. Required if state is 'new', ignored for other states.

options.name: requesterId
options.description: The ID of the requester. Required if state is 'new', ignored for other states.

options.name: state
options.description: The sate of the change object.

options.name: templateId
options.description: The ID of the template to use. Required if state is 'new', ignored for other states.
